    def ik(self, targets: dict, seed=None, base_pose=None, **opts) -> dict:
        """Inverse kinematics: {frame: [x,y,z, quat]} (frames from spec()['kinematics']['ik_targets']) and an optional seed q ->

        body = {"op": "ik", "targets": {k: [float(v) for v in p] for k, p in targets.items()}, **opts}

+"""Camera-guided single-episode controller for the raisin-box task.
+
+Run with a phase argument. Every action continues the existing episode; there is
+no reset. Images and metadata are saved after each phase for visual inspection.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/runs")
+BOX_X, BOX_Y = 0.403, 0.193
+DOWN = [-0.0000003, -0.7071068, 0.7071068, 0.0000002]
+
+
+def record(result, name):
+    path = OUT / name
+    result.save(str(path))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "name": name,
+        "done": result.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": result.meta.get("reason"),
+        "plan": result.meta.get("plan"),
+        "control_steps": result.meta.get("control_steps"),
+        "tcp": result.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15],
+        "opening": result.meta["proprio"]["now"][24],
+    }, indent=2))
+    return result
+
+
+def move(robot, name, x, y, z, grip, q=DOWN):
+    return record(robot.submit("ee_pose", [[x, y, z, *q, grip]], video="none", depth=True,
+                               note=name), name)
+
+
+def main():
+    phase = sys.argv[1]
+    robot = Robot()
+    if phase == "hover":
+        move(robot, "hover", BOX_X, BOX_Y, 0.17, 0)
+    elif phase == "pregrasp":
+        move(robot, "pregrasp", BOX_X, BOX_Y, 0.07, 0)
+    elif phase == "grasp":
+        move(robot, "grasp", BOX_X, BOX_Y, 0.025, 0)
+        move(robot, "closed", BOX_X, BOX_Y, 0.025, 1)
+    elif phase == "lift":
+        move(robot, "lift", BOX_X, BOX_Y, 0.20, 1)
+    elif phase == "bin":
+        move(robot, "above_bin", 0.66, 0.03, 0.20, 1)
+    elif phase == "release":
+        move(robot, "released", 0.66, 0.03, 0.15, 0)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(phase)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
